name: manga-sub-translator
description: Cross-platform embedded comic reader with local OCR and configurable translation routes.

scripts.test:runtime: bash -n start.command stop.command scripts/*.sh && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config --quiet && BONG_BONG_DOMAIN=koharu.example.com BONG_BONG_AUTH_KEY=test-key docker compose -f deploy/remote/docker-compose.yml config --quiet
scripts.test:platform: npm test --prefix packages/protocol && npm test --prefix packages/domain && npm test --prefix services/broker && npm test --prefix desktop
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:manifest && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:platform && npm run e2e
